Diego R: Hey all, first-day question. My monitor arrived with a big dent on the corner and the upstream USB hub isn't in the box. Dock powers but no USB ports active. Also I only see RedwoodGuest at my apartment Wi-Fi. Opening ticket INC-11011.

Claire (IT): Welcome Diego! Ugh sorry about damaged kit. Can you drop a quick photo of the monitor damage and the packing slip? Also what's the hub model printed on the box (if any)? We'll triage for replacement vs RMA. For Wi-Fi: remote staff should use VPN; are you trying to join Okta from Guest?

Diego R: Photo: https://imgur.com/xyz987  packing slip shows asset tag AT-7789 and "Redwood USB-HUB-7P" but the hub is missing. I tried Okta from Guest and the popup was blocked. Laptop is 14" M2; dock is "RedDockPro".

asset-bot: Asset INC-11011 created; asset-tag AT-7789 recorded.

Claire (IT): Thanks. Two things: (1) I'll schedule a pickup for the damaged monitor and request a replacement shipout. (2) I'll add a loaner USB hub courier to the pickup so you have ports meanwhile. For Okta: if the Guest blocks popups we can temporarily whitelist your IP for auth. Can you paste your public IP?

Diego R: IP is 34.201.44.12. Also quick question: is there a VPN package preinstalled on the company image or do I need to run the installer?

it-bot: INC-11011 state updated to "in_progress" by Claire (IT)

Claire (IT): We preinstall SecureConnect on image but sometimes the final SSO step needs to run locally. Quick install snippet if needed:
```bash
# mac
curl -O https://internal.redwood/downloads/secureconnect.dmg
open secureconnect.dmg
# sign in via Okta
```
I'll temporarily allow 34.201.44.12 to reach auth.redwood.internal for 90 minutes.

ship-bot: Pickup scheduled for monitor (INC-11011) tomorrow 10:00-14:00. Loaner hub dispatching via UPS same-day. Tracking will be posted here.

Diego R: Thanks Claire  hotspot workaround worked for the Okta popup so I completed SSO and VPN connected. Can you confirm the loaner hub has an ethernet passthrough? My home AP can be flaky and I'd prefer wired if possible.

Claire (IT): Loaner is USB-HUB-7P-LR which includes one gigabit ethernet passthrough and 85W PD. I'll note it on the courier manifest. If the dock still shows no USB after swap we'll exchange the dock too.

People Ops: Welcome Diego! :tada: If the replacement monitor needs to go to a different address than your onboarding form, DM me and I can update shipping.

asset-bot: Loaner asset HUB-LR-334 assigned to INC-11011.

Diego R: Appreciated. One last tiny ask: could you pre-enable screen sharing permissions on the laptop image so I don't hold up my first meeting?

Claire (IT): We can't pre-grant macOS privacy perms, but I can remote with you and walk through the prompts so it only takes 2 mins. Will ping before the meeting.

it-bot: INC-11011 state updated to "awaiting_pickup"

Diego R: Perfect, thanks everyone. Off to orientation now :wave:
